## Pre-specified rule: profile advantage over each nuisance baseline (treatment level)

Supported in a protocol only if the lower 95% compound-bootstrap bound of the paired accuracy difference is above 0 against all three nuisance baselines.

| NSC | +0.874 [+0.787, +0.940] | +0.796 [+0.667, +0.895] | +0.748 [+0.598, +0.860] | supported |

| NSCB_week | +0.707 [+0.558, +0.840] | +0.707 [+0.558, +0.840] | +0.652 [+0.468, +0.812] | supported |
